status: hand-authored pre-implementation acceptance fixtures; not an unbiased benchmark

semantics.required_skills: Lower-bound availability via selected metadata or complete current native-eligible fallback, not a ranking/order oracle. Explicit by-name and native-disabled exceptions use their stated modes. Pinned skills count as available.
semantics.must_not_force: Do not mandate skill activation; extra visible metadata is allowed.
semantics.fallback_allowed: Full current native-eligible catalogue is safe but must not be reported as selective routing success or prompt reduction.
semantics.fallback_required: An explicit complete-catalogue route is required alongside any candidates; semantic uncertainty is not silent omission.
semantics.eligibility: Native effective registry resolves path/name/kind/disabled state before optional presentation filtering. No query invents permissions.
